message: Reviewed from dated primary evidence using the Codex subscription.

data.headline: QQQ: the long-rate hurdle rose as overnight funding eased.
data.summary: A higher US ten-year yield puts more pressure on the valuation of distant earnings, all else equal. A lower overnight financing rate is a different observation. Neither measures how investors repriced growth stocks.

bull.text: SOFR fell 3 basis points to 3.94% on November 4. That eased the overnight secured rate even though the longer Treasury benchmark had risen the previous day.

bear.text: On November 3 the US ten-year yield reached 4.95%, up from 4.91%. A higher discount rate matters more for cash flows further in the future, but a company’s earnings outlook also matters.

watch.text: Nasdaq-100 futures asset managers were net long 65,381 contracts and leveraged funds net long 2,301 on October 27. The same sign across groups is dated positioning, not a fresh growth-stock signal.

limitations: No QQQ price, option chain, company discount rate or analyst revision is measured here. The rate observations are for different maturities and dates.
The available evidence does not support a calibrated forecast or a directional trading call.

sources.title: CFTC · NASDAQ MINI - CHICAGO MERCANTILE EXCHANGE · 2026-10-27
